		MATT-Bench Overview
	

MATT-Bench provides two large-scale benchmarks for Mistake Attribution (MATT) — a task that goes beyond binary mistake detection to attribute what semantic role was… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/yayuanli/MATT-Bench.
evaluation_method: F1 (per-class and macro F1 for fine-grained mistake attribution), plus class-wise accuracy and temporal localization metrics
reputation: New CVPR 2026 benchmark (dataset pending public release) expected to attract interest in egocentric video and action/error attribution research but not yet widely adopted.
